combo.description: For a more advanced Shuffle E Q towards your target. While still moving, R them back towards your team.
When out of range use W, quickly E and Q to reposition, then AA.
To execute the Shurima Shuffle E Q towards your target, Flash behind and then R them quickly.
To move quickly, use W then instantly E Q.
All in a target by using E Q towards them and then R them back towards your team. Quickly W then AA them down.
To trade and fight, use W and AA, then E, Q and AA again.
Your basic trade is to W then AA, followed by Q AA.
To create a gap between you and the enemy, R them away and then W. AA, Q and AA again, then W and AA.
